title: Window-advance machine
statement: Define a deterministic machine with three work tapes, Boolean symbols, and states built from the half-state space, a disjoint union of a singleton and two counter values, another half-state space, and an additional half-state component. It is formed by composing two repetitions of the one-symbol pattern $[\mathrm{false}]$ around a machine that writes `true` on tape $1$ and advances, with a release step on tape $0$; the indicated sweep and counter controls specify the entry and exit states of these components.
caveat: The machine components and the composition and release operations are not defined in the supplied statement, so their exact behavior cannot be stated.
